list.item: Editor’s Note: The identification of the persons on this list is generally limited to positions and circumstances under reference in this volume and is confined to the years 1955–1957. All titles and positions are American unless otherwise indicated. Where no dates are given, the individual usually held the position throughout the period covered by the volume.
